title: Cornell Taiwanese American Society
content_html:
The Cornell Taiwanese American Society (CTAS) is a registered student organization at Cornell University in Ithaca, New York. It describes itself as a non-political social club that aims to celebrate Taiwanese culture within the Cornell community, providing a welcoming environment and support network while sharing Taiwanese culture through events and activities.

CTAS is a member of the Intercollegiate Taiwanese American Students Association (ITASA), connecting its members to the broader national Taiwanese American college community. Documented recurring events include a Night Market featuring homemade Taiwanese food and games, a bubble tea kickoff event, ice skating outings at Lynah Rink, and a holiday hot pot and Secret Santa gathering. The organization has been active on the Cornell events calendar for at least a decade, with records on the Cornell events platform dating to at least 2015.

CTAS maintains a website at cornelltas.com (also listed as cornelltaiwaneseas.com on its Facebook page) and a Facebook page. No Instagram account was confirmed from first-party sources.
